reading_b.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-06）
reading_b.绑定: 情态动词can/would/should/不规则复数(menus/children/people)/时间介词(in the evening/ on Sunday)
paragraphs: My family likes eating out. On Sundays, we usually go to a restaurant near our home. The restaurant has many kinds of food. We can order noodles, rice, fish and vegetables. My father would like beef noodles. He always eats a large bowl. My mother likes tomato and egg rice. She says it is healthy.

I am a child, but I can use chopsticks well. I would like a small bowl of mutton noodles. My little brother is only five years old. He should eat soft food, so he usually has porridge. The people in the restaurant are very friendly. We often go there in the evening. We always have a good time.

questions.q: When do they usually go to the restaurant?
What would the writer's father like?
What does the underlined word "children" mean in Chinese?
Why does the little brother have porridge?

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-06）
reading_c.绑定: 可数/不可数食物名词/量词结构/情态动词should/时间介词
paragraphs: Eating healthy food is important. We should eat different kinds of food every day. We need rice, noodles, vegetables and fruit. We also need some meat, fish and eggs. Milk and juice are good drinks, but we should not drink too much cola.

Breakfast is important. In the morning, we can have an egg, a cup of milk and some bread. At noon, we usually eat rice with vegetables and fish. In the evening, we should not eat too much. A bowl of soup and some vegetables are good for us.

Many children like fast food, like hamburgers and potato chips. But fast food is not healthy. We should not eat it too often. Remember: you are what you eat. Good eating habits help you stay strong and happy.

questions.q: What does the writer think about fast food?
When should we not eat too much according to the passage?
What is the main idea of the passage?

w5.title: 根据短文内容，从方框中选出最佳句子填入文中空白处，使短文通顺连贯（有一项为多余选项）
paragraphs: Welcome to our restaurant! Let me tell you something about our food. ___1___ We have beef noodles, mutton noodles and vegetable noodles. They are all very delicious.
We also have rice and dumplings. ___2___ You can try pork and cabbage dumplings. They are our special.
___3___ We have green tea, black tea, orange juice and apple juice. They are all fresh and nice.
___4___ Come and enjoy your meal today!
candidates: We have many kinds of noodles here.
I hope you like our food.
Dumplings are very popular in our restaurant.

cloze.title: 完形填空
paragraphs: It is Sunday today. My family goes to a new restaurant. There are many ___1___ of food on the menu. My father would like a large ___2___ of beef noodles. My mother would like rice with fish. She says fish is ___3___ for her health.

I want to try the dumplings. There are fifteen ___4___ in a plate. My little sister is only three years old. She ___5___ eat by herself, so my mother helps her. We also ___6___ two cups of green tea. The tea is hot and nice.

The people in the restaurant are very ___7___. They smile and say hello to us. We usually go to a restaurant ___8___ the evening on weekends. The food here is good and not expensive. We ___9___ come again next time. Would you ___10___ to try this restaurant, too?

grammar_fill.title: 从方框内选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺完整（每空限填一词，每词限用一次）
paragraphs: There is a restaurant near my home. I often go there ___1___ my family on weekends. The restaurant has many ___2___ (kind) of food. We can ___3___ (order) noodles, rice, dumplings and so on.

My father would like a large bowl of beef noodles. My mother likes tomato and egg rice. She says vegetables ___4___ (be) good for us. I like mutton dumplings. There are four ___5___ (dumpling) in a small plate. We usually go there ___6___ six o'clock in the evening.

The people in the restaurant are very friendly. They always say hello to us. We ___7___ (should) eat healthy food. ___8___ (child) should not eat too much fast food. We often have a good time ___9___ Sunday evening. The food is delicious and not expensive. Would you like ___10___ (come) and try it?

sa.title: 阅读表达
paragraphs: Last Saturday evening, my family had a special dinner at home. My mother cooked beef noodles, tomato soup and vegetable salad. She can cook very well.
My father helped her. He set the table and washed the dishes after dinner. I helped too. I made a cup of green tea for my mother. She said it was great.
We talked and laughed during the dinner. My little brother is only four years old. He can't use chopsticks well, so my father helped him. We had a big meal and a happy time.

questions.q: When did they have a special dinner?
Can the little brother use chopsticks well?
Why does the writer say the dinner is special?
questions.answer: Because the whole family cooked and ate together, and they had a happy time.

questions.q: 请把文中画线句子翻译成汉语（My mother can cook very well.）

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请根据以下要点提示，写一篇80词左右的短文，介绍你最喜欢的一家餐厅。
要点：
1. 餐厅的名字和位置；
2. 你最喜欢的食物及原因；
3. 你通常什么时候去、和谁一起去；
4. 你对这家餐厅的感受。
sample: My favorite restaurant is Happy Noodle House. It is near my home, on Green Street. I often go there with my family on weekends.

The restaurant has many kinds of noodles. I like beef noodles best. They are delicious and not expensive. A large bowl of beef noodles costs only 18 yuan. My mother likes tomato and egg noodles, and my father likes mutton noodles.
We usually go there on Saturday evening. The people there are very friendly. The restaurant is clean and quiet. We always have a good time there. I hope you can come and try it someday.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 80 词；2. 包含所有提示要点；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。
